```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Endangered Species Act serves a noble purpose, which Americans overwhelmingly support.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party remains committed to the goal of protecting species to enhance their chances for survival.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Successes under the Endangered Species Act have been limited over the last 30 years due to confrontation and polarization.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"An ever-growing barrage of litigation has prevented the Fish and Wildlife Service from protecting new species and recovering plants and animals already listed as threatened or endangered.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans believe greater progress in protecting species for future generations can be achieved through results-based cooperative conservation programs and voluntary agreements that encourage private stewardship.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Endangered Species Act must be updated to reflect new approaches that focus resources on species in need of recovery, not lawsuits.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Endangered Species Act should require peer-reviewed science so resources can be focused on the most pressing recovery efforts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Endangered Species Act should encourage expansion of voluntary agreements with private property owners while ensuring that Endangered Species Act enforcement respects and upholds private property rights.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
